B.eligible_cells: every grid cell intersecting the bounding box

A.eligible_cells: grid cells whose lower-left origin lies inside the bounding box
A.in_bounds_detections: detections in the uncovered boundary strip excluded from the fraction

area_caveat: occupied_cell_fraction counts grid cells (each eligible cell has weight 1, including boundary cells that extend outside the bounding box). It is not area-weighted and is not a burned-area, fire-count or severity measurement.
missing_data_note: null values indicate no satellite detections after quality filtering, not confirmed zero fire activity. Short baseline (2019-2024, max 6 years per month) limits statistical confidence.
